0022600023.text: The Warriors, 2-3 and 10th in the West, host the 4-1 Lakers, who sit first in the Pacific, in Golden State's sixth game of the 2026-27 season and a West Group C Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Golden State is 0-1 at home and riding a two-game winning streak, while Los Angeles has won its last game; the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision, while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Los Angeles beat Golden State 127-105 in their last meeting, in Los Angeles on October 21, 2026, and the Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 1-3 in 2025-26.
